card.name: Section numbers after Adverse Reactions

modes.label: Open parenthesis
modes.description: The bracket that opens the section number after Adverse Reactions in a see-reference.

modes.label: Space before number
modes.description: The space after a comma and before a section number inside a cross-reference list.

card.plain: It marks the spot in a label's cross-reference where a section number like 6.1 comes next.
